_comment: Indexed external technical research, benchmarks, and compiler design references used in Archx.

german_umbra_strings.summary: 16-byte string representation storing u32 length + 4-byte prefix in word 0 and either 8 inline bytes (<= 12 B total) or a pointer in word 1. Enables register-only short strings and O(1) prefix-rejected equality without pointer dereferences.

arena_bump_allocators.summary: Bump-pointer arena allocation inside contiguous 64 KB slabs reduces temporary batch allocation to 2 pointer instructions and O(1) watermark reset, outperforming per-object malloc/free by 8-10x on allocation-heavy loops.

aos_vs_soa_vectorization.summary: Splitting Array-of-Structs (AoS) into Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) contiguous 16B-aligned planes avoids loading untouched fields into L1 cache lines and eliminates SIMD gather/shufflevector blend instructions in LLVM LoopVectorize.

llvm_o2_pipeline_and_overflow_intrinsics.summary: -O2 provides the release sweet spot (IPSCCP, Inliner, SROA, InstCombine, IndVarSimplify, LoopVectorize) without -O3 icache bloat; @llvm.sadd/ssub/smul.with.overflow.i64 provides deterministic overflow checking without signed-overflow UB.

windows_msvc_ucrt_printf.summary: On x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, UCRT moves classic printf/sprintf wrappers into legacy_stdio_definitions.lib; linking raw LLVM IR calling @printf via clang on MSVC Windows requires -llegacy_stdio_definitions.

python_pep709_inlined_comprehensions_and.summary: Python 3.12 PEP 709 inlines list/dict/set comprehensions into the enclosing frame while isolating loop variables; PEP 695 introduces `def fn[T](...)` and `class Box[T]:` scoped type parameter syntax. Archx compiles both ahead-of-time via single-allocation pre-sizing and full AST monomorphization.

branchless_filter_compaction_vs_rust_fil.summary: Rust's `std::iter::Filter` cannot implement `TrustedLen` and emits a conditional branch per item, incurring 15-20 cycle CPU branch-misprediction stalls (~3-4x slowdown on ~50%-selectivity shuffled data). Pre-allocating upper-bound N once and emitting unconditional `out[w] = val; w += zext i1 cond` eliminates reallocs, capacity checks, and mispredicted branches.

llvm_loop_vectorize_metadata_and_noalias.summary: Attaching distinct `!llvm.loop` metadata (`llvm.loop.mustprogress` + `llvm.loop.vectorize.enable`) onto single-exit counted comprehension/reduction latches alongside `noalias align 16` output buffers enables LLVM LoopVectorize to emit wide SIMD vector loops.

inline_pdqsort_and_planar_schwartzian_ke.summary: libc `qsort` performs O(N log N) indirect function-pointer calls that prevent inlining and register passing, Pythons `sorted` boxes a `key` tuple per element, and Rust `sort_unstable_by_key` recomputes key(x) O(N log N) times while swapping full-width structs. Archx instead emits an inline `fastcc` **stable bottom-up merge sort**: O(N log N) compares and moves with no quadratic worst case (so no heapsort fallback and no recursion depth guard, unlike PDQSort/introsort), runs of 16 insertion-sorted first, then log2(N) ping-pong merge passes; `key=...` uses a **Planar Schwartzian transform** that evaluates the inlined key exactly N times into `{ key, orig_idx }` records and applies the resulting permutation as a raw byte gather, so owned payloads are moved rather than cloned and stability holds even for `reverse=True`.

inbounds_getelementptr_poison_hoisting.summary: An `inbounds` getelementptr whose result lands outside the allocated object is immediate poison, even when the address is never loaded from. Computing base[j-1] before testing j > lo therefore lets LLVM fold the enclosing function into arbitrary behavior: at -O1/-O2 the stable insertion-sort pass collapsed into `free(): invalid pointer` plus corrupted output, at -O0 it happened to work. Fix is structural, not a hint - the sentinel/bounds test becomes its own basic block that branches around the address and load, so the gep is never speculative. Diagnosed by bisecting the emitted IR (`getelementptr inbounds` -> `getelementptr` made the same IR correct) and then re-hoisting the guard in src/codegen/sort.rs.
